北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，体感稍凉 4℃，别忘了添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels a bit cool at 4℃. Remember to dress warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天有风，体感 3℃。注意保暖，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and windy, feels like 3℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴沉微凉，体感 4℃。外出多穿点，注意防潮哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, feels like 4℃. Dress warmly and mind the dampness.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨蒙蒙，体感 11℃。出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, feels like 11℃. Don't forget your umbrella, watch for slippery roads!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 12℃，有风。早晚温差大，别着凉！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy, feels like 12℃ with wind. Mind the temp difference, stay warm!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 2℃，风大。驾车慢行，注意添衣保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and feels like 2℃ with wind. Drive carefully and dress warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，体感 3℃，记得开车慢点。注意保暖哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like 3℃. Drive slowly and remember to keep warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 15℃。早晚微凉，记得备件外套。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 15℃. It's cool in morning/evening, bring a jacket.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 10℃。昼夜温差大，穿衣别大意。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Mind the day-night temp difference, dress wisely.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 10℃。天气干燥，多喝水润润喉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is partly cloudy, feels like 10℃. It's dry, so drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 15℃。注意湿度高，保持心情愉快！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 15℃. High humidity, keep a cheerful mood!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -8℃，非常寒冷！出门务必多穿，小心路滑。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -8℃, very cold! Bundle up when going out, watch for ice.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾，体感 -5℃。外出注意防护，做好保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has haze, feels like -5℃. Take precautions outside and stay warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 15℃。早晚温差大，记得添件外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Big temp difference, remember a jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 12℃，风力 3级。出门小心有风，多穿点。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 12℃ with 3-level wind. Mind the wind, dress warmly.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 2℃。能见度低，开车请务必小心慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like 2℃. Low visibility, please drive extra carefully.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，体感 -1℃。天气寒冷，出门记得戴口罩、穿暖和。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has haze, feels like -1℃. It's cold, wear a mask and bundle up when out.
